jobs.description_text: About the Role Figure is seeking a Head of Investor Relations to own and execute the company’s investor relations program. jobs.description_text: About this role Our Applied AI/ML Science team builds and maintains the models that power the marketplace. Better predictions give retailers confidence in what they're buying and, in turn, help brands sell more on Faire. What you will be doing You'll own a focused project in one of these areas: Predicting how an order will be packed : Before an order ships, we have to anticipate how it will be packed. Understanding products from a catalog: Listings often lack reliable weight, size and shape. We'll help you relocate to a market where your skills are needed, with the possibility of moving again as our fleet grows and new opportunities emerge. jobs.title: Head of Marketing - Bolingbrook, IL
jobs.description_text: About the team: Formic's Marketing Team is the growth engine behind our commercial expansion. We move fast, experiment boldly, and build systems that scale. We work in close lockstep with Sales, RevOps, and Leadership to generate pipeline, sharpen our message, and get in front of the right manufacturers at the right time. This team is small, high-impact, and driven - and we're looking for someone who can match that energy. About this role: As our Head of Marketing, you will build, optimize, and lead a scalable engine for creating demand and qualified pipeline. You will own how Formic shows up in the market, how we identify and reach the manufacturers we can help, and how we turn that engagement into high quality opportunities for Sales. This is a broad, hands-on role spanning Marketing, lead generation, Sales Development, and GTM Engineering and managing a team to deliver across those areas. You'll bring those capabilities together around a common goal: creating qualified pipeline and quantifying through data and insights what's driving it. As Formic grows, you'll help determine how the team and these capabilities evolve. We're looking for someone who combines creativity with operating rigor. You'll set strategy, but you'll stay close enough to the work to understand what's actually happening. You'll establish clear priorities, ownership, and metrics, and make decisions based on results. When something works, you'll scale it. When it doesn't, you'll change it or stop doing it

jobs.description_text: About the role: Health-E Commerce is growing Patiently, our owned digital health and telehealth business, into new conditions and new distribution channels. We're hiring a VP of Marketing to lead the brand's marketing strategy as it expands — leading the team, refining how we go to market, and driving growth across a growing set of conditions and channels. The VP, Marketing is the most senior marketing role on Patiently. You’ll own the brand’s growth strategy, positioning and brand, go-to-market for each new condition and channel, demand generation and lifecycle, budget, and measurement. This person will draw on the resources and infrastructure of Health-E Commerce while moving quickly and owning outcomes directly. The role is both strategic and hands-on. Safety and accuracy matter enormously in all of it. You will help define the real-time architecture, driver standards, and hardware interfaces of mission-critical embedded systems across R&D, manufacturing/test, and plant operations, working hands-on with hardware from early prototypes through deployed systems. If you seek high impact and are excited by fast-paced, intense, Skunkworks-style projects, we encourage you to apply to join our team. jobs.description_text: About This Role General Matter builds its own technology: the software, firmware, control systems, and infrastructure that run an industrial nuclear fuel facility. At most companies, a security bug costs you data. Here, the software we build, and any security vulnerabilities we miss, touch the real world. The Security team's job is to find those gaps before anyone else does. We do that through offensive testing, code audits, design reviews, and hardening the systems we ship. As an intern on the team, you'll attack General Matter's products and infrastructure, while working with the engineers who own them to fix what you find. Targets include web apps, APIs, Linux and Windows hosts, cloud environments, embedded devices, and industrial controllers. You'll own real projects from start to finish, and you won't be writing policy documents Responsibilities Break everything you touch, then help us fix it. Run penetration tests against General Matter networks, services, web applications, and APIs. Prove what you find with working proof-of-concept exploits. Audit source code and features for security vulnerabilities in languages like Python, C, C++, Rust, Go, and TypeScript. Then build static analysis rules or CI checks so the same class of bug can't come back. Reverse engineer and attack embedded devices and industrial equipment on an isolated test bench.
